issues_detected.description: The description claims the release covers 'single-cell CRISPRi Perturb-seq for MDA-MB-468 cells with and without treatment' and each MDA-MB-468 subset lists 'Perturb-seq data for the untreated condition' / 'for the treated condition', but file_collections contains only KOLF2 Perturb-seq archives (cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_cell_atlas.zip, cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_raw_sra.zip) and third_party_sharing states 'the Perturb-seq deposits for KOLF2.1J iPSCs and for MDA-MB-468 cells are listed as embargoed'.
issues_detected.recommendation: State in description and subsets that MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq data are embargoed external deposits, not part of the ten distributed archives.

issues_detected.description: cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_raw_sra.zip is described as a 'Raw sequence data package ... Listed as 73.3 KB' and raw_data_sources gives raw_data_format 'Sequence Read Archive submission'; 73.3 KB cannot hold raw single-cell reads, so the archive is a pointer/manifest package and the instance 'A raw single-cell sequencing read set' is not what the file contains.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe the archive as SRA submission metadata and point to the SRA/BioProject accession for the reads.

issues_detected.description: Keyword 'mass spectroscopy' is a misnomer; the record's own methods are 'size-exclusion chromatography-mass spectrometry (SEC-MS)' and 'affinity purification-mass spectrometry (AP-MS)'.
issues_detected.recommendation: Use 'mass spectrometry' (source-carried keyword may be retained with a caveat).

issues_detected.description: Version numbering is non-monotonic across the series as recorded: this release is 'version: "2.0"' while related_datasets gives the October 2025 release as 'Version 2.1' and the June 2025 release as 'Version 2.1'. version_access explains each release is 'a separate versioned Dataverse dataset with its own DOI', which resolves it, but a reader of version alone would misread the ordering.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a note beside version that the number is per-Dataverse-dataset, not per-series.

issues_detected.description: Temporal ordering: created_on '2025-02-27' and a 'Deposit Date of 2025-02-27' predate the June 2026 release ('issued: 2026-06-17') by sixteen months and coincide with the March 2025 release date. The record reports the Dataverse value faithfully but does not flag the anomaly in source_caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a source_caveat that the Dataverse creation/deposit date appears inherited from an earlier deposit.

issues_detected.description: External deposits are named without resolvable identifiers: 'MassIVE repository deposits' and 'Figshare deposit of the CRISPRi Perturbation Atlas' carry no accession or URL, unlike the GitHub, FAIRSCAPE and NDEx entries which give URLs.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add MassIVE (MSV...) accessions and the Figshare DOI.

issues_detected.description: errata documents a revision of a different dataset ('The June 2025 release was revised to version 2.1'), not of the June 2026 release described by this record; no erratum for doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C itself is recorded.
issues_detected.recommendation: Move the June 2025 revision note into related_datasets and state that no errata are recorded for this release.

semantic_insights: DOI prefix 10.18130 is the University of Virginia Dataverse registrar, consistent with publisher 'ROR:0153tk833' (University of Virginia) and page 'https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C'.
Grant numbers '1OT2OD032742-01' and '5U54HG012513-02' follow the NIH application-id pattern, and the RePORTER core project 'OT2OD032742' is cross-referenced with a URL.

Ethics claims are internally coherent for a non-human-subjects dataset: 'involves_human_subjects: false', irb_approval 'Not applicable', is_deidentified.method explains 'No de-identification procedure was applied ... commercially sourced, already de-identified ... cell lines', and sensitive_elements_present is false.
Cell-line identifiers use correct Cellosaurus RRID format: 'MDA-MB-468 (RRID:CVCL_0419)' and 'KOLF2.1J (RRID:CVCL_B5P3)'.

The record separates the Nature U2OS article from CM4AI ('It describes a dataset distinct from the CM4AI cell-line data releases') and records eight explicit source disagreements in source_caveats rather than silently merging them.

known_biases uses schema enum values ('representation_bias', 'selection_bias') with mitigation_strategy and affected_subsets, and future_use_impacts repeats the generalisation caveat as a user-facing risk.

Provenance is stated at the standards level ('provenance expressed using the EVI Evidence Graph Ontology and PROV-O') and as a processing lineage in preprocessing_strategies, but the record itself carries no parent_datasets or was_derived_from links.

questions.evidence: preprocessing_strategies (5): node2vec PPI embedding, HPA image embedding, 'contrastive deep learning' co-embedding, community detection, FAIRSCAPE packaging; cleaning_strategies (2); labeling_strategies: 'aligned to known protein function and pathway resources, including the Gene Ontology and Reactome' plus LLM naming with 'a name confidence score'; machine_annotation_tools lists five tools with descriptions; missing_data_documentation populated; extension_mechanism gives the GitHub URL.

questions.name: Data Integrity, Provenance Graph, and Quality
questions.description: Version access, errata, updates, derivation, provenance graph
questions.score_label: Version history plus described lineage, no in-record provenance graph
questions.evidence: version_access, errata, updates populated; raw_data_sources (4) with access_details; missing_data_documentation with patterns, causes and handling; subsets (5); related_datasets typed 'is_new_version_of'/'continues'; conforms_to: 'provenance expressed using the EVI Evidence Graph Ontology and PROV-O'; preprocessing_strategies: 'Each segment of the pipeline calls the FAIRSCAPE client to validate its inputs and to build an RO-Crate output package ... computation of the provenance graph entailments'; file_collections carry MD5 checksums.

questions.name: Bias Documentation and Responsible AI Alignment
questions.description: Known biases with taxonomy and fairness analysis
questions.score_label: Categorised biases with mitigation, no AIO mapping or fairness analysis
questions.evidence: known_biases: 'bias_type: representation_bias' ('Two donors are represented in total, one for each cell line') with mitigation_strategy; 'bias_type: selection_bias' ('Molecular targets were chosen as a designed panel rather than sampled at random') with affected_subsets; sampling_strategies 'is_random: false, is_representative: false' with why_not_representative; future_use_impacts repeats the generalisation risk.
questions.quality_note: Biases use the schema's enumerated types and are tied to specific subsets, which is systematic categorisation; there is no AIO/CROISSANT RAI mapping and no fairness analysis beyond the donor caveat, which is the appropriate depth for cell-line data but short of the rubric's 5.

strengths: Collection protocol is documented at instrument and reagent level for all four modalities, with performing laboratories and dates.
Governance and licensing are complete and mutually consistent: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, per-package copyright holders, unrestricted confidentiality, named governance contact.
Sustainability is fully documented (Dataverse DOI, institutional preservation funding, quarterly update plan, five prior releases with DOIs).
Source disagreements are surfaced in eight source_caveats entries and a distinct dataset (Nature U2OS map) is explicitly excluded rather than absorbed.
Ethics fields are coherent for a non-human-subjects dataset and cell lines carry correct Cellosaurus RRIDs.
weaknesses: Description and subsets claim MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq coverage that is not among the distributed files and is elsewhere recorded as embargoed.
Only two declared media types; the formats inside the ZIP archives are not named.
resources, parent_datasets, variables, was_derived_from and download_url are unpopulated even though the prose describes data dictionaries, prior releases and access routes.
Software tools lack version numbers and several are named generically; external MassIVE and Figshare deposits lack accessions.
The 73.3 KB 'raw sequence data package' is mischaracterised as raw reads.
recommendations: Reconcile description and subsets with file_collections regarding MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq, marking it as an embargoed external deposit.
Populate parent_datasets/was_derived_from from related_datasets, and variables from the JSON-Schema mini-data-dictionaries the record says exist.
Name the file formats inside each ZIP archive (image format, MS result format, SRA metadata) in file_collections.
Add MassIVE accessions, the Figshare DOI and download_url; add cellmaps_pipeline and FAIRSCAPE version numbers to machine_annotation_tools.
Add a source_caveat for the 2025-02-27 creation/deposit date preceding the June 2026 release, and move the June 2025 revision out of errata.
